apiKey.title: Companies House API key
apiKey.description: Your own free REST API key from https://developer.company-information.service.gov.uk/ (Register an application > Create new key > REST, live). Needed for the Companies House modes; the GLEIF modes need no key. Without a key, lookup mode returns GLEIF LEI records for the company numbers instead. Stored encrypted as a secret input and never logged.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Companies House modes (need your free key): lookup, search, advanced_search. GLEIF modes (no key, any country, CC0): gleif_lookup, gleif_ownership (direct and ultimate parent from GLEIF Level 2 data), gleif_search.
enumTitles: GLEIF: search LEI records by name / register number

companyNumbers.title: Company numbers
companyNumbers.description: Lookup mode: Companies House numbers, e.g. 00000006, SC123456, OC301540. Leading zeros optional. Max 5,000.

query.title: Search text
query.description: Search mode: company name or number.

companyNameIncludes.title: Name includes
companyNameIncludes.description: Advanced search: words the company name must include.

companyNameExcludes.title: Name excludes
companyNameExcludes.description: Advanced search: words the company name must not include.

companyStatus.title: Company status
companyStatus.description: Advanced search: active, dissolved, liquidation, receivership, administration, voluntary-arrangement, converted-closed, insolvency-proceedings, registered, removed, closed, open.

companyType.title: Company type
companyType.description: Advanced search: e.g. ltd, plc, llp, limited-partnership, private-limited-guarant-nsc.

location.title: Location
location.description: Advanced search: registered-office town/postcode text, e.g. Manchester.

leis.title: LEI codes (GLEIF modes)
leis.description: gleif_lookup / gleif_ownership: 20-character Legal Entity Identifiers, e.g. 7LTWFZYICNSX8D621K86 (Deutsche Bank). Max 5,000.

gleifName.title: GLEIF: legal name
gleifName.description: gleif_search: legal or other name to match.

gleifRegisteredAs.title: GLEIF: national register number
gleifRegisteredAs.description: gleif_search: the company's number in its national register (e.g. a UK company number, Finnish Y-tunnus, French SIREN).

gleifCountry.title: GLEIF: country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2)
gleifCountry.description: gleif_search: legal-address country filter, e.g. GB, DE, FI.

fetchFullProfiles.title: Fetch full company profiles
fetchFullProfiles.description: Search modes: fetch the full profile (accounts and confirmation-statement dates, previous names, charges/insolvency flags) for every hit. Uses one extra API request per company.

filingHistoryItems.title: Latest filings per company
filingHistoryItems.description: Attach the N latest filing-history items (type, date, category, document link). 0 = off. Officer names are removed from filing descriptions.

includeCharges.title: Include charges (mortgages)
includeCharges.description: Attach registered charges: status, classification, dates. Chargeholder names are not output (count only).

includeInsolvency.title: Include insolvency cases
includeInsolvency.description: Attach insolvency case types and dates (practitioner details are not output).

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Search modes: maximum companies to return.
